description: This file contains serializers, surrogates, and deep copier implementations for the ConcurrentQueue<T> type within the Orleans.Serialization framework.

classes.name: ConcurrentQueueCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for ConcurrentQueue<T> using a surrogate for serialization.

classes.name: ConcurrentQueueSurrogate<T>
classes.description: Surrogate representation of ConcurrentQueue<T> for serialization purposes.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a surrogate back into a ConcurrentQueue<T> instance.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a ConcurrentQueue<T> into its surrogate form for serialization.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input ConcurrentQueue<T>.
